ayahs.3: These opening letters—known as the muqatta'at—are among the signs whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself. They open the surah by reminding the reader that this Book is from beyond human authorship: approach it with humility, not arrogance.
ayahs.5: and plunging into the centre of battle! Allah swears by this scene of energy and sacrifice to expose a deeper truth:
ayahs.6: Humanity is deeply ungrateful to its Rabb—quick to forget blessings once urgency fades.
ayahs.7: And humanity bears witness to its own ingratitude by how it lives.
ayahs.8: Truly humanity is intense in love of wealth—
ayahs.9: Do they not know that when what is in the graves is emptied out—
ayahs.10: and what is hidden in chests is exposed—
ayahs.11: their Lord on that Day is fully aware of them—nothing deleted, nothing archived beyond reach.
